title.zh: 消灭传病昆虫（规定表格）条例
title.en: Destruction of Disease-Bearing Insects (Prescribed Form) Regulations

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Destruction of Disease-Bearing Insects (Prescribed Form) Regulations.

2. Every notice served by the Commissioner, a police officer, a Medical Officer of Health or a public health auxiliary under section 23 of the Act shall be in accordance with the Form set out in the Schedule.
